subject.title: fix(agents): skip model-override repair and visibility gate for locked sessions

question: Should every plugin-created session marked `modelSelectionLocked` be allowed to bypass `agents.defaults.models` visibility and generic override repair in both execution paths?
rationale: The code is internally consistent, but accepting the patch establishes that the lock flag outranks the operator-facing model visibility policy, which is an ownership and provider-routing boundary requiring maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve authoritative locks
options.body: Treat plugin-created locked sessions as owner-controlled selections, retain this implementation, and land after exact-head checks complete.

options.title: Restrict eligible owners
options.body: Narrow the exemption to registered durable harness or CLI-backend owners and add focused eligibility tests before merge.

recommendation.title: Approve authoritative locks
recommendation.body: Treat plugin-created locked sessions as owner-controlled selections, retain this implementation, and land after exact-head checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent model-discovery and routing work makes this the best available owner signal for deciding precedence between plugin-owned session locks and core visibility policy.
